title: New Student Organizations - Campus Activities
lines: Published September 2, 2021 Last Updated July 24, 2026, 9:16 am

Applications for the creation of new RSOs are accepted in October of each academic year for recognition in Spring semester. Only applications for groups that were recognized in the previous academic year are processed in fall semester. This allows staff to provide focused support to new RSO applicants in Spring.
Please visit the FAQs page for more information on RSO recognition. You may add your name to a mailing list about the new RSO process by submitting this Google form .
If you have any questions, please email stuacts@usc.edu .
